roleLabel: Item-eating Vanguard — frontline that converts gear into permanent stats and Shards
bestFor: Players who like managing item slots and want a Vanguard who funds the run while holding the line
strength: Wheel and Deal stuns and can spit items; Rank paths turn items / Shards into permanent power
weakness: High micro of item order — wrong consumes waste value; also needs Max HP to stay relevant as a frontliner

howToPlay.early: He can be your first tank if you feed Max HP. Put disposable or low-value items left-most if you are on the consume path so Red Hot Deals eats trash, not your best piece.
howToPlay.mid: Executive wants more item slots and Rush Shields per item. Hoarder wants Shard generation and Vanguard/Tank retaliation. Dealer/consume path wants a steady item pipeline.
howToPlay.late: Treat Niklas as economy + frontline hybrid. Keep Max HP and Rush tools coming; do not turn him into a backline caster.
howToPlay.positioning: True front row on the engage path. He stuns what he hits — make sure the mace connects with the scary pack, not a stray trash mob.

abilityNotes.Wheel and Deal: Stun + Max HP scaling smash. The item-create chance is gravy — build him to survive and connect, not to fish procs.

specNotes.The Dealer: Item-consume / permanent stats path (pairs with Red Hot Deals). Take when you can keep feeding him leftover shop items.
specNotes.The Executive: More item slots and Rush Shields per equipped item — take when you actually fill those slots every fight.
specNotes.The Hoarder: Team retaliate scales with Shards generated this game. Take on Shard-heavy Vanguard/Tank boards, not solo Niklas greed.

relicReasons.vanguard-equipment-6020: Speaks directly to his item-slot identity.
relicReasons.vanguards-aegis-banner-537: Helps him live as the engage tank while the economy engine spins.
relicReasons.defensive-amplifier-2016: Max HP / defensive amp keeps the front line honest.

faq.question: Is Niklas good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Yes if you enjoy item management and Vanguard frontline. No if you want a simple “buy and forget” carry — mis-ordered items punish you.

faq.question: What class is Niklas?
faq.answer: Vanguard. Role focus: item-consuming economy engine who still stuns and tanks.

faq.question: What relics work with Niklas?
faq.answer: Vanguard equipment/aegis pieces, defensive amplifiers, and Rush tools if you took Executive.

faq.question: How do you play Niklas?
faq.answer: Park him front, grow Max HP, control which item sits left-most for consumes, and pick Executive when slots are full or Hoarder when Shard generation is high.

tips: Before each combat, glance at item order — left-most is the consume candidate on the deals path.
Hoarder without Shard income is a trap; take it only when the run already prints Shards.
